It seems that Nb atoms with a large atomic radius (i.e., 0.1429 nm, see in Table I) dissolve into the CoCrNi alloy, which intro- duces an increase of the lattice distortion and results in an increase of lattice parameters.
the hardness improvement of the CrCoNiNb x alloy system is mainly caused by Nb element solid solution strengthening and the formation of Laves phase.
the strengthening mechanism of lamellar eutectics includes the second-phase strengthening, solid solution strengthening, and boundary strengthening.
Nb0/periodori4 alloy exhibits fully eutectic lamellar structure (see in Figs. 4(f) and 5), thus numerous boundaries of FCC matrix and Laves phase result in a higher yield strength.
